sentences.reason: The abstracts cover low-precision LLM training but do not describe private devices.
Paper 1 examines FP4 recipes, selective higher precision and gradient estimation.
Papers 2 and 3 describe those quantization techniques and training results.
Paper 7 describes approximately 4-bit activations, 8-bit gradients and GPU-cluster speed improvements.
Paper 6 concerns private fine-tuning, not low-precision training across devices.
